monopsony.def: A market with a single buyer, most often one employer that hires nearly all the workers of a kind in an area. It faces the upward-sloping labor supply curve.

monopsony-wage.def: The wage a monopsonist pays: it hires where MRP = MFC and pays the wage read on the labor supply curve at that quantity. Its wage bill is that wage times the workers hired.

minimum-wage.def: A legal lowest wage. In a competitive labor market a binding minimum wage lowers employment; in a monopsony, one set between the monopsony wage and the competitive wage can raise both the wage and employment.
